docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,000.00 FILED BY ASSOCIATED BUILDERS AS TO DEFENDANT RUBIN, KATHLEEN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-30-1999 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ASSOCIATED BUILDERS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT RUBIN, KATHLEEN $3,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $26.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,026.00, PROOF OF SERVICE WAIVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
